faqs: What affects the cost of a kitchen remodel?

The size of the kitchen, cabinet scope, countertop and tile selections, existing conditions, and changes to plumbing, electrical, or layout all affect cost. We prepare a project-specific estimate rather than promise a one-size-fits-all price.
Can I update the kitchen without replacing everything?
Yes. Depending on the condition of the room, a focused cabinet, backsplash, flooring, or finish update may suit your goals. Tell us what you want to keep so we can discuss practical options.
How long will my kitchen renovation take?

Timing depends on scope, selections, material availability, and any required trade work or approvals. We discuss access and kitchen downtime and confirm scheduling when the work and materials are defined.
Should I buy cabinets or appliances before contacting you?

You can share products you are considering, but confirm dimensions, compatibility, supply responsibilities, and lead times before ordering. Photos of your kitchen are enough to begin the conversation.

faqs: What affects the cost of a bathroom remodel?

Room size, demolition, tile coverage, waterproofing, fixtures, glass, and layout changes affect cost. Existing moisture damage and needed repairs can also change the scope. We identify confirmed work and unresolved conditions in the estimate.
Can you replace a bathtub with a shower?
We can discuss a tub-to-shower conversion and assess the available space, drainage, plumbing, waterproofing, and glass requirements. Final scope depends on the existing bathroom and your selections.
How long will my bathroom be unavailable?

Bathroom downtime depends on the work, inspections where required, curing times, deliveries, and glass installation. We discuss access to another bathroom and confirm the proposed sequence before work starts.
Can you help with a bathroom that has leaks or damaged tile?

Tell us about visible leaks, staining, loose tile, or soft flooring. Photos help start the discussion, but concealed conditions may need an on-site assessment or investigation. New tile alone does not resolve an underlying waterproofing problem.
